g.text: Local Docker vs. Railway (beta, actual) vs. Forge (ADR-0001, never built)
is what makes isSecure() true past this point.
Without it: http:// links, broken image URLs
(the public disk builds them from APP_URL),
and a Secure cookie the framework thinks
ADR-0022's stock release depends on it, and
check on the box, do not assume.
runtime is lost on redeploy. The 182 demo
images survive by being IN the image.
The gap between these boxes is why deploy-and-host.md exists.
Anything fixed only in this repo's docker/nginx/*.conf, or
only in the local .env, is invisible to both
deployed topologies — it has to be set again,
Railway is the only one of the three that has
actually run. Forge remains a checklist, not a box.
